pages.text: Dark colored and vicious counterparts of regular goats, these dark omens will ram onto their masters enemies or skewer them with their horns, or bites if they lose them.

One can call upon twilight goats through the use of a $(l:focuses/wild/hunting_focus)Hunting Focus$() while on a mountain, or through casting it with a $(l:crafts/staff/wind_staff)Wind Staff$(), or through a ritual which summons one without a limited lifespan.
Right-clicking on a loyal Twilight Goat with any type of edible food will heal them.
